reviews.author: jamie seger
reviews.text: Tyler with Rodeo Electric was very professional. He did great work and was very fairly priced. When I have electrical needs done again, he will be the first person that I call.

reviews.author: Tonya Farlow Bennett
reviews.text: Tyler @Rodeo Electric is an exceptional Electrician! We had a pretty major electrical issue at our home late at night & not only did Tyler insist on coming over immediately to ensure our safety, he was able to diagnose the issue quickly. The next morning, he had everything prepared and ordered to install a brand new electrical panel for our home. Even in the midst of a Major snowstorm, he worked until the job was completed , and our home had power! I would highly recommend using Rodeo Electric for all your electrical needs!

reviews.author: Gary Rodis
reviews.text: We found Rodeo Electric and decided to use them our first time to install our Tesla home charger. Tyler was punctual, professional and courteous.He came prepared with everything to get the job done. We were extremely happy with his service. He cleaned up and asked if we had any questions. We will definitely call on him again for our next project and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him Thank you Tyler!!
